args.message:
Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (FIN-212)

round_money was rounding with ROUND_HALF_UP despite the docstring and
tests expecting banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212. This
made the nightly build fail tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (FIN-212)
args.body:
### Summary
`src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring and the tests (`tests/test_money.py`) require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212. This caused the nightly build failure.

**Change:** Switch the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so that e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68` and `2.665 -> 2.66` (ties round to the even cent).

### Testing
CI run `ci-0001` (commit `08d3cd5986`) passed on branch `fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding`, including `tests/test_money.py`.
